name: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City, UT) Shaved Ribeye Philly Cheesesteak (Hold Peppers Mod)
brandOrRestaurant: Cody's Gastro Garage (Garden City / Bear Lake, UT)
whyItWorks: Thinly shaved tender ribeye steak with melted provolone cheese on a soft hoagie roll. Holding grilled peppers eliminates gas-inducing fibers.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Philly Cheesesteak with melted provolone on a soft roll; ask to hold grilled bell peppers and raw onions.
watchOuts: Hold bell peppers and onions to prevent gas and bloating
